lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Brendan Becker is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Brendan is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Brendan Becker is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Brendan kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Brendan's gone." Carmela looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Brendan." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Miguel blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Brawler's Instinct (Level 1). You read a fight as it moves. The body tells you what the mouth won't.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Brendan Becker, 41 days. The mantle passes to Miguel Santos.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Miguel Santos, 49 — a dockworker. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Brendan — and Brendan is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Lily, Carmela, Serikbol and 5 more speak for Miguel — "Brendan trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Miguel before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.

d84: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d84: 🕯️ Miguel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d84: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)
d84: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d84: 🕯️ Miguel's funeral feast: 3,000 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold, Ashford. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d84: MIGUEL — GONE. 1 open question closed unanswered.
d84: 🕯️ Miguel Santos is dead — the night. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d84: What Miguel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d84: "Miguel's gone." Daniyar looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Miguel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d84: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lily blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Shield Wall (Level 1). Shoulder to shoulder in the wilds, you brace as one. While an ally fights beside you, blows that reach you land softer — the line holds together or not at all.
d84: 📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
d84: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d84: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Miguel Santos, 84 days. The mantle passes to Lily Keita.
d84: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lily Keita, 23 — an infantry soldier. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Leech, Bird Whisperer, Trophy Room, Pack Hunt, Fusion Reactor.
d84: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Beastmaster of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d84: The village's quarrel was with Miguel — and Miguel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d84: You knew Miguel — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting him, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
d84: At the grave, Carmela, Serikbol, Daniyar and 4 more speak for Lily — "Miguel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d84: The fire knew Lily before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d110: 🍽️ Owen rests a hand on the pantry door, satisfied. "No one's going hungry this week. Sitting with the fever cases instead — someone should."
d110: 🍽️ Daniyar watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."

d110: 🌙 Raid — Emberhold came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust
d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+11 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
